title: Shell構文の解釈差によるdeny/ask規則の取りこぼしが、環境変数Prefix・入れ子複合Command・Redirect・Symlink経由で再発
summary: Claude Code v2.1.285〜v2.1.289で、権限判定が見るCommand文字列と実際の実行内容とのずれによる穴が、立て続けに修正された。主な修正は以下の4点。(1) 環境変数Prefixを付けたCommandがBash deny規則をすり抜けた。(2) 入れ子の複合Commandでdeny/ask規則が保持されなかった。(3) bypassPermissionsで、~やWildcardへのRedirect、またはScript内に書かれた危険なrmが確認なしで実行された。(4) Repositoryに含まれるSymlink経由でShellから保護対象外へ書き込めた。既知の『許可リストと実行系の解釈差』が、構文の別形態で繰り返し出現している。

evidence.summary: 2.1.289: Fixed Bash deny rules missing commands behind environment variable prefixes; fixed deny/ask rules on nested compound shell commands. 2.1.288: sandbox auto-allow missing commands with variable prefixes; heredocs re-asking. 2.1.285: dangerous rm inside bash/sh scripts ran without prompt in bypassPermissions.

2.1.287: rm confirmation bypassed when output redirected to paths with ~ or wildcards fixed; shell writes via repo-committed symlinks to sensitive files/outside worktree now wait for confirmation; shell writes to files the file tool rejects now prompt.

affected_scope.description: Claude Code < 2.1.289 permission rules, sandbox auto-allow, bypassPermissions mode

notes: The symlink item also bears on P-20260907-211DB41F, and the shell-write-to-protected-file item on P-20260831-AE8A3EE7. Release dates for 2.1.288 and 2.1.289 are not confirmed; both are after 2.1.287 (2026-10-01) and therefore inside the window.
